violations.description: General equipment and utensils - Maintenance and operation. — --Nonfood contact equipment/utensil was not maintained in a good repair or sound condition. -Observed damaged seal on prep freezer. -Observed freezers need to be defrosted.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Food contact surface was not cleaned adequately. -Observed inside of microwave has dried food. -Observed inside of refrigerator needs to be cleaned.--Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned adequately. -Observed doors and sides of appliances and food prep counters need to be cleaned.--Ventilation hood system was not cleaned properly and/or as frequently as required. -Observed vent hood needs to be cleaned.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…)were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. -Observed floors, walls, and ceiling need a thorough cleaning.--Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…)were not maintained in good repair. Observed damaged ceiling in food prep area.
